versions.changelog:
unisonud-followup-mgmt 1.0.1

- Removed the unnecessary file skill-card.md from the package.
- Updated default model in documentation from u1-insuremed to u2-med.

Initial release: Structured health exam follow-up management skill

- Generates time-based follow-up plans (1/3/6/12 months) based on exam reports
- Provides clear itemized rechecks, departments, targets, and health coaching points
- Lists alert symptoms and key focus areas for the next annual check-up
- Ensures strong data privacy: minimal data use, de-identification, and no local storage
- Outputs both structured JSON and human-friendly follow-up notifications
